S.od.tag: Two orbits. One tap. Every jump on the beat.
S.od.lead: A rhythm arcade in deep space: one tap switches orbits, and every jump lands on the beat of our own music. Five levels, an endless mode, eleven ball trails and RANKS — your country’s board and the world’s.
S.od.new: **RANKS**: climb your country’s board and the world’s, with 4 weekly tournaments and gem prizes every Monday. Style your orbit — ball, trail, orbit shape and anthem — and win the exclusive STARDUST ball and FLARE trail. Coming soon to iPhone, and the whole game already plays in your browser.
S.od.evText_halloween: Until November 30, Orbit Dash dresses up for Halloween: the menu becomes a moonlit night with witches, bats, cobwebs and candlelit pumpkins, your ball turns into a pumpkin with a ghostly WISP trail — both free for Halloween — and three spooky tracks join the music. On December 1 it all goes away on its own.

S.p.vlad.who: Vlad, Android and LibGDX developer · Poltava region, Ukraine
S.p.vlad.bio: Writing code since 2017: Java first, Kotlin a year later. A full-time game developer since 2021, from trainee all the way to Team Lead at a game studio. Every Lewydo game is built with Kotlin and LibGDX, Android first.
S.p.lilya.bio: Websites, presentation design and social media visuals are her main field. Thanks to Vlad she stepped into game design too, and every Lewydo game carries her touch. *Between us: websites are still her first love* 😉
S.story.title: Our story so far
S.story.1.d: Vlad writes his first code. A year later he switches to Kotlin and stays with it for good.
S.story.2.d: Vlad leaves the Military Institute of Telecommunications behind and goes full-time into games: trainee, junior… all the way to Team Lead.
S.story.3.d: A developer meets a designer. The studio doesn't know it exists yet.
S.story.4.d: Same day, different month — a team forever.
S.story.brand.d: Vlad always ended his [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) articles on LibGDX, Android and Kotlin the same way: «Love what you do» and a green heart 💚. That sign-off became our brand.
S.story.imc.d: IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 is released on Google Play.
S.story.idea.d: Vlad is serving in the Armed Forces of Ukraine. One morning he wakes up in a house where his unit is staying on an assignment — with the idea of CubePix in his head.
S.story.od.d: We make Orbit Dash and publish it on Google Play: two orbits, one tap.
S.story.proto.d: The first playable prototype: famous paintings revealed cube by cube.
S.story.pix.d: We invent the CubePix mascot: a little pink painter cube with a beret and a brush. His name is Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, so the game carries his name.
S.story.l10n.d: Our biggest job yet: the studio site, both game sites and the games themselves — CubePix and Orbit Dash — learn 82 languages, so everyone can play in their own. For twelve days the laptop never switched off. Two Claude accounts worked side by side: one was paid by the game company where Vlad was a Team Lead ($120), the other was on Lilya's email ($120) — and when every weekly limit ran out, it grew into a $200 Max ×20 plan. One account built prototypes on the web straight from GitHub; the other ported what was finished into the real Android and iOS games. At that company, Vlad's colleagues — developers Nasuf and Taras — were great guys; it's a pity that once Claude Code got this good, layoffs followed.
S.story.l10n.d2: That's when our rule was born: Prototype → Game, never the other way round. Nothing changes in a game directly — first the prototype, then the game, so whatever we see in the prototype is exactly what's in the game. We hope you'll feel the difference in your own language.
S.story.l10n.photo: The desk in those days: the laptop that ran for twelve days straight, with the Android and iPhone test phones beside it.
S.story.live.d: Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) plays Orbit Dash in a TikTok LIVE — the first streamer ever to go live with our game.
S.story.live.video: Andrii plays Orbit Dash live on TikTok
S.story.live.thanks: Thank you, Andrii, for being my first streamer to go live playing my game. Thank you so much!
S.story.web.t: The web becomes a real platform
S.story.web.d: After that stream, Vlad starts taking the web seriously. Until then we made games only for phones — Android and iOS — and the web version of Orbit Dash was just a demo to get a taste of the game. But streamers and players clearly want to play on a computer too, so Vlad takes on a full port to the browser.
S.story.web.d2: Now we have one more platform: Orbit Dash and CubePix are the full games on the web as well — nothing to install, just open and play.
S.story.web.photo: Orbit Dash and CubePix in the browser — the same full games as on phones.
S.story.sale.d: Someone from Italy buys REMOVE ADS in Orbit Dash for $3.99 — and $3.03 reaches us. The first dollars our games have ever earned. Grazie mille! 🇮🇹
S.story.ios.t: Orbit Dash goes to the App Store
S.story.ios.d: For the first time, a Lewydo game is sent to App Store review — Orbit Dash for iPhone and iPad, with all 82 languages and RANKS. Fingers crossed! 🤞
S.story.next.d: Coming this month — the exact date very soon.

S.cp:tagline: REVEAL THE PICTURE CUBE BY CUBE
S.cp:lead: A calm puzzle for art lovers. Fill the cubes layer by layer, and famous paintings, wonders of the world and little pixel treasures come to life. Every picture ends with a museum label and a true story.
S.cp:about: Lewydo is a two-person indie game studio from Ukraine. Vlad codes, Lilya designs. Together we make the games we love to play.
S.cp:how: Your cube shows a number. Tap the cells with the same number, or swipe across them in one long chain: chains score more.
S.cp:demo: A painting from the museum, revealed layer by layer
S.cp:pixName: He’s a cube, and his name is Pix. Put the two together and you get CubePix: the game carries his name.
S.cp:evText_halloween: Until November 30, a Halloween floor is open: 8 spooky pictures, from a black cat and a witch’s hat to a haunted house and Kuniyoshi’s giant skeleton. The whole museum dresses up for the holiday, a Halloween waltz joins the records, and finishing the floor dresses Pix as a jack-o’-lantern.
S.cp:evDress_halloween: The whole game dresses up for Halloween: every screen gets its own pumpkins, bats and cobwebs, witches brew potions by the menu and fly across the moon, and autumn leaves drift down.

strawberry.f: A strawberry isn’t a true berry: each tiny “seed” on it is a separate fruit with a seed inside.
